title: A year-to-date measure grouped by month accumulates through months without sales

source.quote: This example shows the sales in the current and both the
source.supports: the example groups by month with SUMMARIZECOLUMNS and shows Sales YTD accumulating month by month

source.quote: this ALL statement is automatically applied when you apply a filter over a column of Date type that is the primary key in a relationship
source.supports: a filter on the date key removes the filters on the other columns of the Date table

derivation: Sales by month of 2024: Jan 300, Feb 700, Mar 500, May 600, Jul 700, Dec 800; the other months have none (BLANK). The running total within the year: 300, 1000, 1500, 1500, 2100, 2100, 2800, 2800, 2800, 2800, 2800, 3600. Months without sales still have a YTD, so SUMMARIZECOLUMNS keeps their rows. The filter DATESYTD puts on Date[Date] removes the filters on YearMonth and Year (see date-filter-removes-other-date-table-filters).
